item.title: AllSkills
item.description: AllSkills is a Skills mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Unlocks all skills at once — for players who want the full build without the grind. item.title: Apostles Of Ambition
item.description: Apostles Of Ambition is a Content mod for Core Keeper available on Steam Workshop. Large content expansion: 14+ unique armor sets, 3 unique weapons, a playable music system and a hidden story told through a mystery transceiver. What it does Large content expansion: 14+ unique armor sets and 3 unique weapons Adds a playable music system Hidden story told through a mystery transceiver item Steam Workshop only; supports Japanese How to install Open the Steam Workshop page for this mod and click Subscribe — the game installs it automatically on next launch.

item.title: AutoFish
item.description: AutoFish is a Fishing mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io by xiaoye97. Fully automatic fishing — auto-cast, auto-hook and auto-reel. Idle-friendly; works while you alt-tab. Does not work with the legacy fishing mini-game setting. What it does Auto-cast, auto-hook and auto-reel with zero input after start Stops automatically when you interact, so it never fights your play Does NOT work with the legacy fishing mini-game setting — check your options Best idle setup: stand surrounded by water on all four sides How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.

item.title: Core Keeper Mods FAQ — Install, Compatibility, Safety
Core Keeper Mods Guide — Where to Download, How to Install and Essential Mods
item.description: Core Keeper supports official modding through Steam Workshop and mod.io, with community content managed by the CoreLib framework. This modding guide covers where to find mods, how to install them, and the most useful quality-of-life mods. Where to get mods Platform What it is Notes Steam Workshop Official in-game mod browser One-click subscribe & install; requires the game mod.io Cross-platform mod repository Browsable online, official Core Keeper page CoreLib Community mod framework / loader Most mods depend on it; install first Check the Mods hub for an indexed list of popular mods and their patch compatibility.
